scope: Machine-readable assets needed to distinguish the 42-image high-density Manual analysis set, the 30-task/420-annotation Label Studio export, and the 5-image x 8-worker DEV feasibility package. Broader uncertainty outputs are represented only where they define membership, provenance, or a non-additive superset.

count_contract.tasks: Label Studio runtime/import task rows unless task_unit says otherwise.
count_contract.annotations: Observed, non-cancelled annotation rows unless annotation_basis says selected_canonical, historical_prior, or zero_observed_dev.
count_contract.workers: Distinct worker_id/completed_by values where encoded; planned workers are explicitly marked.
count_contract.k: Per-image annotation support. Planned K and selected/strict-valid K are explicitly distinguished from raw K.
count_contract.markdown_policy: Markdown is never used for a numeric count. When mentioned, it is marked reported_not_recomputed and used only as a status/eligibility clue.

high_density_42.meaning: 42 distinct stage-conditioned Manual base-image units selected by the RQ1 raw recompute: 30 P1 Manual plus 12 C1 Manual anchor images.

project_28_30_tasks_420_annotations.meaning: Only the Chinese P1 Manual Label Studio project/export. Its 30 images are all 30 P1 members of high_density_42, but it is only one language/worker slice.

dev_5_images_x_8_workers.meaning: A DEV-only planned Semi feasibility rerun: 5 images, 8 planned workers, 40 assignment rows, and no observed DEV export yet.

records.merge_rule: Membership source for the P1 Manual exports; never add its 30 task rows to export annotations.
records.overlap: 30/30 images match the P1 part of high_density_42.
records.evidence: Counts recomputed from JSON array length and distinct data.base_task_id.
records.unresolved_questions: Import alone does not encode the deployed worker roster or achieved K.

records.merge_rule: Combine with project 39 by base_task_id and canonical worker/annotation identity; do not treat language projects as different images.
records.overlap: All 30 images are in high_density_42; zero overlap with DEV5.
records.evidence: Counts recomputed directly from task annotations and completed_by fields.
records.unresolved_questions: 420 is raw project support, not the final bilingual canonical support.

records.evidence: Counts recomputed directly from task annotations and completed_by fields.
records.unresolved_questions: Raw union contains duplicate/version records removed by the canonical selector.

records.evidence: Union recomputed directly from both JSON exports.
records.unresolved_questions: Three raw rows are not retained by the selected-canonical view.

records.evidence: Counts recomputed from both JSON arrays and distinct data.base_task_id.
records.unresolved_questions: Imports do not encode achieved support.

records.overlap: All 12 images are in the C1 part of high_density_42.
records.evidence: Counts recomputed directly from JSON export.
records.unresolved_questions: Raw support includes versions removed by canonical selection.

records.evidence: Counts recomputed directly from JSON export.
records.unresolved_questions: Raw support includes versions removed by canonical selection.
